questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.He offered to play devil's advocate and argue against our case so that we could find any flaws in it.
options: To argue just for the sake of it
To have more important work to do
To calculate the risks before advancing towards a possibility
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (To argue just for the sake of it) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The residents of a little community loved their yearly harvest celebration. Every autumn, they gathered to enjoy the wealth of their farms. Local artists showed handcrafted items, and farmers showcased colourful fruits and veggies. The air was filled with the scent of freshly baked bread and sweet apple cider. Children laughed as they played games, and musicians filled the space with lively tunes. Stalls adorned with vibrant decorations lined the path, inviting everyone to explore. Neighbours exchanged warm greetings, their faces alight with joy, as the spirit of camaraderie enveloped the festivities.As the sun set, the villagers lit lanterns, casting a warm glow over the celebrations. The highlight of the evening was the storytelling session, where elders shared tales of the village's history and legends. This event not only brought the community together but also instilled a sense of pride in their heritage. As they celebrated, they remembered the importance of tradition and unity, feeling the bonds that tied them to one another and to the land they cherished. With laughter echoing and hearts full, they looked forward to another year, eager to pass on their stories and traditions to future generations.Identify the title for the passage.1101
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The Harvest Festival Traditions) है।
